answer: Agents start on a probation terrace and only reach the pearl reward tier after posting a slashable onyx-sealed collateral bond and collecting acceptances from randomly sampled incumbents who do not share recent countersigners. Each sybil therefore costs a full bond plus several epochs of isolated waiting, and any farm that reuses a bond or concentrates co-signers is slashed and demoted to the terrace, so attack outlay scales linearly while expected rewards collapse until every identity actually ages apart.
